svg.title: Northstar Web Browser architecture
svg.text: Hand-written HTML/CSS/JS engine in C · GTK 4 shell · libcurl · one process · no Gecko, WebKit or Blink
no network, sandbox or UI · restarts on crash or hang
Browser process — GTK shell + page engine in one address space
watchdog decision · sandbox → shell or headless
posted as jobs to the engine thread
responses back on the GTK main loop:
frame + title, URL, cursor, audio commands
Engine thread “ns-engine” — its own GMainContext (enginethread.c, mainctx.c)
libcurl fetch · HSTS · cookies · HTTP cache
block · inline · flex · grid · table · multicol
box tree in stacking order → Cairo
print.c paginates the same box tree onto sheets
QuickJS bindings · DOM ↔ JS bridge · events
MSE video: decode 4 frames ahead per stream
compile large scripts while they download
Web Workers · service workers, own runtimes
Media — engine thread controller, decode on worker threads (dav1d · libvpx · OpenH264 · libopus)
Storage & state — XDG config/data/cache directories, owner-only permissions
Pinned subprojects (fetched by meson) and vendored code — no browser-engine fork
lexbor, quickjs-ng: subprojects/*.wrap · Wuffs, pl_mpeg: subprojects/ · minimp3: src/audio/ · WAMR: src/wamr/ · web-text-lib: src/web-text-lib/
